author: Debug01-dEoW aka Deep
description: EcoDot 1.26v — A vibrant hybrid Android music player with realistic Liquid Glass optics, SimpMusic UI architecture, Apple Music/Vinyl/Spotify player styles, seamless 1080p video mode, AutoMix crossfade, and YouTube Music streaming, made by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep.

New: Signature Now Playing Styles: Apple Music (6x6 dynamic mesh gradients, inline lyrics strip, dock controls, Queue & Lyrics tabs), Vinyl Turntable (33⅓ RPM platter & tonearm), Spotify obsidian cards, and EcoDot Classic
Real-time audio telemetry badge (kbps · kHz) driven directly by active YouTube stream resolution and Media3 session metadata
Rich User Profile page with persistent local photo avatar uploads, interactive favorite genre chips, 2x2 listening analytics cards, Top Tracks, Recently Played, and one-tap Player Style switcher
SimpMusic-style Search & Browse pages: categorized tabs, quick-access filters, related songs/albums/playlists expansion from Home "More", and integrated Shazam acoustic song recognizer
SimpMusic-style Settings screen with Liquid Glass controls, SponsorBlock skip categories, High AAC (256 kbps), AutoMix dual-deck crossfade, and multi-category storage breakdown
Improved: 120Hz High-Refresh Smoothness & R8 Optimization: hardware 120Hz Display.Mode selection, isolated playback-position state reads across Now Playing/Seekbars/Lyrics, single-pass backdrop captures, sized bitmap decoding, and full R8 optimization with zero visual compromises
Seamless Video Mode queue transitions: responsive 1080p surface stays active across Next, Previous, and Queue track changes without pausing or reverting to audio mode
Authentic Liquid Glass optics across Home top filter chips (All, Moods, +, Settings) and YouTube Music pull-to-refresh feeds
AutoMix & Crossfade engine with equal-power gain curves and DJ-style low-pass/high-pass filter sweeps (CrossfadeFilterAudioProcessor)
Fixed: Resolved Home deep-scrolling crash and Search backdrop focus crash
Eliminated blurry cover thumbnails by filtering low-resolution placeholders and prioritizing crisp high-DPI artwork URLs
Fixed Profile genre chip layout crash and UpdateDialog initial scroll position
Prevented dual-player AudioFocus contention during crossfades and stale video metadata on subtitle refreshes

changelog:
## New
• Signature Now Playing Styles: Apple Music (6x6 dynamic mesh gradients, inline lyrics strip, dock controls, Queue & Lyrics tabs), Vinyl Turntable (33⅓ RPM platter & tonearm), Spotify obsidian cards, and EcoDot Classic
• Real-time audio telemetry badge (kbps · kHz) driven directly by active YouTube stream resolution and Media3 session metadata
• Rich User Profile page with persistent local photo avatar uploads, interactive favorite genre chips, 2x2 listening analytics cards, Top Tracks, Recently Played, and one-tap Player Style switcher
• SimpMusic-style Search & Browse pages: categorized tabs, quick-access filters, related songs/albums/playlists expansion from Home "More", and integrated Shazam acoustic song recognizer
• SimpMusic-style Settings screen with Liquid Glass controls, SponsorBlock skip categories, High AAC (256 kbps), AutoMix dual-deck crossfade, and multi-category storage breakdown

## Improved
• 120Hz High-Refresh Smoothness & R8 Optimization: hardware 120Hz Display.Mode selection, isolated playback-position state reads across Now Playing/Seekbars/Lyrics, single-pass backdrop captures, sized bitmap decoding, and full R8 optimization with zero visual compromises
• Seamless Video Mode queue transitions: responsive 1080p surface stays active across Next, Previous, and Queue track changes without pausing or reverting to audio mode
• Authentic Liquid Glass optics across Home top filter chips (All, Moods, +, Settings) and YouTube Music pull-to-refresh feeds
• AutoMix & Crossfade engine with equal-power gain curves and DJ-style low-pass/high-pass filter sweeps (CrossfadeFilterAudioProcessor)

## Fixed
• Resolved Home deep-scrolling crash and Search backdrop focus crash
• Eliminated blurry cover thumbnails by filtering low-resolution placeholders and prioritizing crisp high-DPI artwork URLs
• Fixed Profile genre chip layout crash and UpdateDialog initial scroll position
• Prevented dual-player AudioFocus contention during crossfades and stale video metadata on subtitle refreshes
